verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Pilot automates bookkeeping via software integrated with human review (comm-2) and offers real-time expense tracking (docs-13), implying some form of automated transaction import, but no evidence explicitly describes connecting bank/credit-card accounts or a daily import cadence. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of bank/card account linking, confirmation of daily sync frequency, and any independent/hands-on account of the connection process.
